t: From Private to Public: A Practical Guide to Migrating Your GitHub Pages Repo
s: This article details migrating a Jekyll-based GitHub Pages site from a private to a public repository to avoid paid service fees, involving irreversible Git history wiping and proactive asset cleanup via a Python script.
sub: Migrating GitHub Pages from private to public repositories
Irreversibly wiping Git repository history with orphan branches and force push
Automating unused image deletion with a Python script
Enabling GitHub Pages on a public repository
